items.question: Eɛni agbur d baṭel?
items.answer: Nefka timsirin tizmimin baṭel d yibriden unzifen s uxxalas. Tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ aṭas n tmesras mebla axxalas.

items.question: Ad awiɣ aselkin?
items.answer: Ih, iselkinen yettwasenqden ttwunefken mi tfukkeḍ timsirin d yibriden n ulmad.

items.question: Zemreɣ ad lmadeɣ s tazzla-iw?
items.answer: S tidet. Akk agbur-nneɣ yettwaglam akken ad tlmmdeḍ melmi i k-yewata deg wakud-inek.

items.question: Tella tallelt ma ufiɣ ugur?
items.answer: Ih, inelmaden n Premium sɛan anekcum ɣer yiseqsiyen d uselmad d yisenburen n tmetti.

items.question: Zemreɣ ad lmadeɣ ɣef tilifun?
items.answer: Ih akk. Tansa-nneɣ temcabi d tilifunat d tfelwin. Tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ ividyuten, ad teɣreḍ iḍrisen u ad txedmeḍ ikayaden seg yal allal.

items.question: Llant tewtilin n unekcum i tmesras?
items.answer: Timsirin n yimaynuten ur sɛint ara tiwtilin. Timsirin tunzifin sɛant timusniwin i yettwasutren yettwalsen deg yisebtar-nsent.

items.question: Acḥal n tikwal i yettwabeddel ugbur?
items.answer: Agbur n tmesras yettwasekked u yettwabeddel dima akken ad imcabi d ulzuz. Mi tjerreḍ, tettwaliḍ akk ibeddilen baṭel.

items.question: Amek i tettheggi Podacium aswir-iw?
items.answer: Mi ara tjerreḍ, tzemreḍ ad twaliḍ ibriden i k-d-nettsemres s lehsab n yiswiyen d tarmit-inek.

items.question: D acu n umgired yellan gar ubrid n ulmad d tmesras timyiyin?
items.answer: Ibriden n ulmad d imsedfaren n tmesras yettwasuddsen iwakken ad k-awin seg unelmad amaynut ɣer umusnaw deg yiwet n taɣult. Fkanten inig yettwaḍefren s yiswiyen ibanen, ma d timsirin timyiyin lhint i tmusniwin neɣ isental unzifen.

items.question: Acḥal n wakud i ilaqen iwakken ad yekfu ubrid n ulmad?
items.answer: Ibriden-nneɣ ttwaselcamen s tazzla-inek. Ihi akud yemxalaf ɣef lehsab n lewɛara n ubrid, maca kra n yibriden ttaken-d akud yettwasekkren yebnan ɣef tazzla talemmast n ulmad.

items.question: Eɛni ad awiɣ aselkin mi ara fakeɣ abrid n ulmad?
items.answer: Ih! Mi tfukkeḍ akk tiɣerɣar yettwasutren deg ubrid n ulmad, ad tawiḍ aselkin yettwasenqden i tzemreḍ ad tebḍuḍ deg LinkedIn d tensiwin nniḍen n yimusnawen.

items.question: Eɛni zemreɣ ad xedmeɣ timsirin deg ubrid s yal amsedfar i bɣiɣ?
items.answer: Ɣas akken tesɛiḍ tilelli, nemlellak-ak ad teḍfreḍ amsedfar i d-nefka acku yal tamsirt tebna ɣef tmusni n tin yezrin. Kra n tɣerɣar tunzifin zemrent ad sutrent timusniwin tizwaranin.

items.question: D acu ara yeḍrun ma yella ur zmireɣ ara ad fakeɣ abrid n ulmad?
items.answer: Tzemreḍ ad tḥebseḍ u ad tkemmleḍ deg yal akud. Asfurret-inek yettwaḥrez i lebda. Tzemreḍ daɣen ad tbeddleḍ gar yibriden n ulmad neɣ ad telḥuḍ d tmesras timyiyin gar ubrid.

items.question: Llant tewtilin n tazwara i yibriden n ulmad?
items.answer: Tuget n yibriden n yimaynuten ur sɛint ara tiwtilin. Ibriden ilemmasen d yinzifen zemren ad sutren timusniwin tigejdanin. Yal abrid yeskan-d s wudem ubayyin akk tiwtilin send ad tjerreḍ.

items.question: Amek i d-tsemres Podacium ibriden n ulmad i yiswiyen-iw n tmahilt?
items.answer: Podacium tettsemres ibriden n ulmad yebnan ɣef umezruy-inek n ulmad d wayen i k-yeɛǧben deg tmahilt. Isemrasen ttemcabin mi ara tkennfeḍ tiɣerɣar, u tzemreḍ ad tbeddleḍ abrid-inek neɣ ad tekseḍ isumaren deg yal akud.

items.question: Eɛni zemreɣ ad waliɣ agbur n ubrid send ad jerreɣ?
items.answer: Yal abrid n ulmad yesɛa asebter n tmuɣli talqayant i d-yesskanayen akk tiɣerɣar, iswiyen n ulmad d wakud yettwarejwan. Tzemreḍ ad tseqdceḍ ahil ačuran send ad tjerreḍ iwakken ad twaliḍ ma yemcabi d yiswiyen-inek.
